interest: Documents prewar American intelligence analyzing Japan's subsidized merchant fleet as naval auxiliaries and tracking worldwide vessel movements.
overview: This file details joint U.S. State Department and Navy Department surveillance of Japan's merchant marine and fishing fleet between 1934 and 1939. It centers on detailed consular analyses from Kobe evaluating the auxiliary naval capabilities, defense installations, and speeds of subsidized Japanese vessels, alongside intelligence monitoring Japanese maritime movements across Mexico, Liberia, and the Caribbean.
